title: Turn the dark theme on or off in Settings

setup.why: Keep the phone's own night mode once (a retried setup keeps the first copy), so teardown puts it back.
Start from the other theme, so the agent has to change it.
Open Settings at its home page, whatever screen an earlier run left it on.

instruction: Using the Settings app, turn the dark theme {{mode.say}}.

checks.why: The system's night mode is what was asked: `cmd uimode night` prints "Night mode: yes" or "Night mode: no". Setup left the other value, so an agent that does nothing fails.

teardown.why: Put the phone's own night mode back (yes, no or auto; anything else becomes no) and drop the saved copy.

argv: f=/data/local/tmp/computer-bench-{{nonce}}.orig; v=$(sed -n 's/^Night mode: //p' $f 2>/dev/null); case "$v" in yes|no|auto) cmd uimode night $v ;; *) cmd uimode night no ;; esac; rm -f $f
